ready1_open_rewrite.title: SciVerse open question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: Three small islands are the habitat of a small portion of mice. Studies found that there are relatively large differences in the angles of these mice's jaw openings. Figure 1 shows the averages of the maximum jaw-opening angles in mouse samples collected from 10 locations on these three small islands. This difference is most likely caused by what difference on each island?
ready1_open_rewrite.expected_answer: different seed sizes on each island

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Three small islands are the habitat of a small portion of mice. Studies found that there are relatively large differences in the angles of these mice's jaw openings. Figure 1 shows the averages of the maximum jaw-opening angles in mouse samples collected from 10 locations on these three small islands. ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: Figure 1 shows three small islands and the average maximum jaw-opening angles of their sampling points. A1, A2, and A3 on Island A are about 21° to 22°; B1, B2, B3, and B4 on Island B are about 31° to 34°; C1, C2, and C3 on Island C are all about 21°. Therefore, the maximum jaw-opening angle of mice on Island B is clearly greater than that of mice on Islands A and C. Then reason: The jaw-opening angle is directly related to whether food can be bitten or handled during feeding. Seeds of different sizes exert different selective pressures on the mice's gape angle and biting method; larger seeds are more likely to require a larger jaw-opening angle. Therefore, this difference is most likely caused by differences in food resources on the islands, especially differences in seed size.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图1标出三个小岛上10个采样位置的平均最大颌骨开口角度，A岛和C岛约21–22°，B岛约31–34°，说明某些岛上的小鼠能张开更大的下颌。再结合题干说这些小鼠生活在不同小岛且下颌开口角度差异大，判断最可能的环境选择压力应是与下颌开口直接相关的取食资源。用生物适应性推理：不同大小的种子需要不同的张口角度和咬合方式，因此每个岛上的种子大小差异最可能导致这种颌骨开口角度差异。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图1显示三个小岛及其采样点的平均最大颌骨开口角度。A岛的A1、A2、A3大约为21°到22°；B岛的B1、B2、B3、B4大约为31°到34°；C岛的C1、C2、C3均约为21°。因此，B岛小鼠的下颌最大开口角度明显大于A岛和C岛小鼠。再推理：下颌开口角度与取食时能否咬住或处理食物直接相关。不同大小的种子会对小鼠的张口角度和咬合方式产生不同选择压力；较大的种子更可能需要更大的颌骨开口角度。因此，这种差异最可能由各岛食物资源，特别是种子大小的差异造成。
method.model_answer: 每个岛上的种子大小不同。
method.answer_match_reason: 预测答案与标准答案表达相同含义，均指出差异最可能由各岛种子大小不同造成。
